Subject: AcmeHealth / Redwood — follow-up: SOC 2, telemetry & vendor questionnaire

Hi Sarah — great to meet with you and Tom today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery on security/compliance and telemetry: 

Call highlights:
- You are primarily evaluating SOC 2 status, HIPAA/GDPR controls, and whether product telemetry could expose PHI/PII.
- Primary use case: clinical notes ingestion + summaries, so HIPAA compliance and data isolation are top priorities.
- You requested our SOC 2 report, DPA, and if we can start the vendor security questionnaire.

Answers / notes:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Q4 2024. I've attached a redacted summary (full report available under NDA).
- HIPAA/GDPR: We offer a HIPAA-ready configuration (BAA available) and a Data Processing Addendum for GDPR customers. We support encryption at rest and in transit, tenant isolation for Dedicated/Private deployments, and KMS integrations.
- Telemetry/PII: By default our hosted console collects aggregated usage telemetry and crash/metrics data. We do not surface raw user prompts in telemetry dashboards. Conversational content retention is configurable: default retention window is 90 days for hosted instances; Dedicated/Private customers can opt for no retention or custom retention/auto-delete policies. We can also provide an option to never persist conversational content for regulated workloads.

Attachments sent: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2024-redacted.pdf, vendor_security_questionnaire_acme.xlsx (attached for you to complete).

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm whether you want the fully redacted SOC 2 now or the full report under NDA.
2) Fill out the vendor questionnaire (we can also have our security team complete any technical Qs).
3) If helpful, let's schedule a technical deep-dive with our security engineer (Neha) and our infra lead (Marcus) to cover logging, retention, and encryption details.

Proposed times: Wed 10/14 10-11am PT or Thu 10/15 2-3pm PT — what works for your team?

Thanks — happy to get you anything else you need.

Best,

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying Qs from our privacy & security team: 

1) When you say "conversational content retention is configurable," does the default 90-day retention include logs, prompts, and generated outputs, or only aggregated metrics? Specifically: are raw prompts and model outputs stored by default?
2) For PHI: if we send health data via API, is there any stage where data is routed through third-party analytics (e.g., Google Analytics) that could capture identifying info?
3) What is your default data deletion workflow and SLA for deletion requests?

We are likely to require a signed DPA + BAA before any demo with real patient data. Please send the DPA/BAA link and the SOC 2 report (or confirm NDA process). Also, can you flag which questionnaire rows we should prioritize (e.g., encryption, access control, logging)?

Tom and I can do the deep-dive Thurs 10/15 2pm PT if that still works.

Thanks,
Sarah

AcmeHealth

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth / Redwood — follow-up: SOC 2, telemetry & vendor questionnaire

Thanks Sarah — answers below and next steps.

1) Retention details: default hosted retention (90 days) includes conversational content (prompts + outputs) unless the customer opts out. Aggregated telemetry and metrics are separate and do not contain raw prompt data. For HIPAA workloads we recommend Dedicated or Private with "no retention" configuration; we can also provide a write-only stream to your storage so Redwood never persists content.

2) Third-party analytics: our public docs site and marketing property use standard analytics (Google Analytics) — we do not send any customer prompt or account-level content to third-party analytics. Console-level telemetry (usage metrics, errors) is processed internally; PII/PHI is excluded from telemetry.

3) Deletion workflow: for hosted accounts we process deletion requests within 72 hours for conversational data and purge from primary storage; backups are retained for up to 30 additional days before secure overwrite. For Dedicated/Private deployments we provide contractual SLAs for deletion and support direct customer-managed lifecycles. We can include this language in the BAA/DPA.

Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2024-redacted.pdf (redacted report). DPA/BAA link: https://docusign.example.com/link/to/dpa (we can start signature now).

Priority questionnaire sections: please prioritize these rows for the initial pass:
- Encryption keys and KMS integration (rows 4-7)
- Access control & least privilege (rows 10-12)
- Data retention & deletion (rows 18-22)
- Incident response and breach notification (rows 30-34)

Next steps: I will loop in Vivek (cc'd) to handle any technical deep-dive items you want us to take offline. I also propose Neha run the Thursday 10/15 2pm PT technical session to go through logging, retention options, and architecture diagrams — confirmed?

If that works, Tom/Sarah please accept the calendar invite and we will have the questionnaire pre-filled where possible.

Best,
Marissa
